facts.fact: The Office national de l'etat civil et de l'identification (ONECI), one body for civil status and identification, carries out biometric census in civil status centres and signed a convention with the DGE on using civil status data.

GIN.note: No count or share of people enrolled is given.
Nothing is stated on a number given at birth.
Who operates or maintains the system is not stated.

facts.fact: The DGE and ONECI signed a convention making data of the registre national des personnes physiques the sole official source of voter identification data for the biometric electoral file, as the DGE director-general states.
ONECI's director-general says the biometric census of citizens in civil status centres is continuing and must not be interrupted, feeding the registre national des personnes physiques.
